rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

POWER: documented prophecy to specialist and healing/fortune; show the active encounter only, NO invented visualmagic for prophecy or healing [jengu-c02,c05,c08].

LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm sunset shaft through water, very deep walnut-green shadows, dramatic rim on hair and fish scales, natural bubbles.
SURFACE: rich brown natural skin, wet coarse opaque cloth, textured mermaid scales, long hair.
SETTING: river/sea waters of Cameroon, traditional Jengu sacred context [jengu-c01,c10].
MOOD: majestic protective spirit, solemn and spiritually commanding, respectful sacred awe; never evil, cute mascot or placid beauty portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, letters, logo, border, watermark; no extra heads or limbs; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons.
